_about: Items the Commission plans for upcoming College meetings, from its tentative agenda. The generator in services/scrapers/ec_college_scraper.py writes them into each meeting's calendar description, so the calendar sync keeps them instead of reverting to the generic text. Refresh from the newest tentative agenda in the EC Transparency Register during /news. Dates are the Commission's plan ('tbc'), never a commitment.
